comment: The maker names no port. PITCH CV is scaled 5Hz per volt rather than one volt per octave (src/controller/SBD.cpp:41), so it is a plain CV input and not a pitch input. The envelope release and the noise burst are fixed divisions of the sample rate at src/controller/SBD.cpp:61 and :67, not controls. The SUB OCT and WAVE switches are three-way and two-way slide switches; their panel markings are -2/-1/-0 and SIN/SQR.
